title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 23200 John R Road in Hazel Park, Michigan, as the "Roy E. Dickens Post Office".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 23200 John R Road in Hazel Park, Michigan, as the Roy E. Dickens Post Office.

summary.headline: A 2022 law renames a Hazel Park, Michigan post office after Roy E. Dickens.
summary.what_it_does: This act names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 23200 John R Road in Hazel Park, Michigan, the Roy E. Dickens Post Office. It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or what customers pay. The official summary does not describe who Roy E. Dickens was.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022, and the name applies from that date.
